ruling: PKT-A-3 bumps the canonical form (U21h section 3, 12 Sep 2026); designated design LD_RETURN_PKT_A_3_MIGRATION_0022_DESIGN_v0_6.md section 9: s015f3 moves to s015f4, vectors regenerate; U21g-27: the canonical record encodes every column
cardinality: eight vectors: seven re-derived from the Phase 2 s015f2 inputs (V1, V2, V3a, V3b, V3c, V4, V5) plus one additional obligation vector (V6)
authored_inputs_note: Columns the s015f2 record did not carry (id, predecessor_id, actor_id, authority_basis_id, the anchor FK, action, references, keys, temporal basis, obligation extras) hold authored values [A]; they are part of the published input. In a live table id and recorded_at are database-assigned. s015f4: the fourteen columns added by PKT-A-3 (design v0.6 section 5.1) hold authored values derived from the act each event represents - a person acting and entering the record themselves: actor_state PARTY, actor_capacity STANDING, enterer_identity_id = actor_id, entry_mode TRANSPORT, composing_rule_state and composer_state NA_TRANSPORT, no end date (effective_until null, effective_until_state NONE), no L2 body. The commitment values are serialization inputs only: see serialization_inputs.
grammar: Envelope   : ["s015f4","<anchor token>","<anchor identity uuid, lowercase hyphenated>",[<record>,<record>,...]]
Record     : JSON object {"<column>":<value>,...} containing EVERY column of the event table, keys in bytewise (C-collation) ascending order of the column name
timestamptz: UTC, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ" (exactly six fractional digits, four-digit zero-padded year), as a JSON string
uuid       : lowercase hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal, as a JSON string

varchar    : JSON string with the mandatory escapes only (" \\ and U+0000-U+001F; \b \t \n \f \r short forms; other controls \u00xx lowercase hex); non-ASCII as raw UTF-8 (Python json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False); PostgreSQL to_json(text)::text)
integer/bigint: JSON number, shortest decimal, optional leading '-', no quotes
NULL       : the literal null; the key is always present
boolean/json: no rule in s015f4 — no such column exists; the serialiser refuses
Order      : records ascending by (effective_at, occurred_at, received_at, recorded_at, sequence, event_uuid)
Eligible   : effective_at <= state_at AND received_at <= known_at AND recorded_at <= known_at (unchanged)
Bytes      : UTF-8, separators , and : with no whitespace anywhere
Digest     : "s015f4:" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes — 71 characters

vectors.title: eligibility, membership — E1 and future-effective E2 at (2026-10-02, 2026-10-02)
eligibility, membership — at (2026-10-02, 2026-09-01T09:00:00Z) E2's recorded_at exceeds known_at: E1 only (identical to V3a)
fold order is the sextuple, not the sequence — Circle; F2 (sequence 2) sorts before F1 on occurred_at, so F2's record-time predecessor set is empty and its prior_state is NULL
one obligation event carrying the four-member projection — under s015f3 every obligation column is a keyed member of the record

serialization_inputs.status: SERIALIZATION INPUTS ONLY - not valid commitments, not live fixture values
serialization_inputs.how_authored: shape-valid strings: s015p1:/s015r1: followed by sha256 of an authoring tag; predecessor_l1_commitment repeats the authored l1_commitment of the predecessor vector event
serialization_inputs.what_they_are_not: none is computed from a parts, L1 or predecessor preimage; none would be accepted by the live guardians; this corpus establishes the canonical grammar over these strings, nothing about commitments

live_rows.l1_commitment: database-assigned at BEFORE INSERT; a caller-supplied value is refused; fixtures supply none
live_rows.predecessor_l1_commitment: caller-declared and verified at commit against the predecessor row's assigned l1_commitment; a fixture reads that value back from the database
live_rows.parts_commitment: caller-declared and verified at commit; a fixture takes the database-computed value
live_rows.l2_commitment: null where no L2 content row exists (the value these vectors use)
live_rows.other_fourteen_columns: each fixture value follows the governing rules for the act the fixture records (design v0.6 section 5.1; BD-1)
